{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
crosstab_segment = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment:")
print(crosstab_segment)

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_age (grouped into bins) to check for imbalance
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])
crosstab_age = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['age_group'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel and age_group:")
print(crosstab_age)"}
